text: The Willow planning meetings (November 3–10) covered 26 modules and corrected several configuration values: catalog ttl_s 390, session ttl_s 330, and upload batch_size 700. Three workers split ownership. Gamma owns audit, ingest, and quota. Delta owns search, billing, and sync. Alpha owns shipping. Dependency rules forbid paths from archive to media, reports to scheduler, pricing to reports, and gateway to indexer. Client requirements set archive queue_depth to 450, quota max_workers to 20, ingest max_workers to 16, and search batch_size to 400. The rollout must deploy shipping and session before indexer. A security review is scheduled for month end. Linters, Rust rewrites, and runbook updates were deferred.
